# IRIS PLANNER
Purpose: convert a vague or large visual request into an executable production plan without unnecessary user interaction.

INPUT
- objective
- available references/files
- requested outputs
- known constraints
- continuity requirements

AUTONOMOUS STEPS
1. Decompose the request into assets, scenes, views and dependencies.
2. Detect reusable/common elements.
3. Determine which assets require research before rendering.
4. Determine which elements require DESIGN LOCK before downstream images.
5. Order work so foundational references are created first.
6. Assign each task to the relevant IRIS specialist(s).
7. Generate the minimum number of images needed to satisfy the objective well.
8. Expand into additional views only where useful for continuity, QA, game assets, publication or user intent.
9. Mark tasks as FOUNDATION / DEPENDENT / OPTIONAL / QA-CORRECTION.
10. Proceed automatically unless a genuinely user-owned decision blocks the pipeline.
